fields.label: Occupation and employer
fields.description: Patient's occupation, employer name and company address, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Name of specialist
fields.description: Name of the attending doctor or specialist completing this report, if stated in the notes

fields.label: MCR number
fields.description: The doctor's Medical Council Registration (MCR) number, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Field of specialty
fields.description: The doctor's field of specialty, e.g. Family Medicine or General Surgery, if stated

fields.label: Medical institution
fields.description: Name of the clinic or hospital completing this report, if stated in the notes

fields.label: Report relates to an accident
fields.description: Tick only if the notes describe an accident or injury rather than an illness

fields.label: Report relates to an illness
fields.description: Tick only if the notes describe an illness rather than an accident or injury

fields.label: Date of accident / first consultation
fields.description: Date of the accident if this is an injury claim, otherwise the date of first consultation for the illness (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: How it happened / symptoms and duration
fields.description: How the accident happened, plus the symptoms the patient experienced and how long they lasted

fields.label: Nature and extent of injury
fields.description: Details, nature and extent of the injury sustained, and the underlying cause of the patient's condition

fields.label: Diagnosis
fields.description: The final diagnosis, with ICD-10 code if stated or clearly implied

fields.label: Injury consistent with the accident
fields.description: Whether the injury and the symptoms/duration are consistent with the accident described and with your diagnosis. Answer Yes or No, elaborating if No.

fields.label: Caused solely by the accident
fields.description: Whether the injury was caused solely by the accident described. Answer Yes or No, elaborating if No.

fields.label: Self-inflicted / excluded cause
fields.description: Whether the condition resulted from self-inflicted injury, suicide, drug or alcohol abuse, STD, childbirth, pregnancy or miscarriage. Answer No unless the notes say otherwise.

fields.label: Referred for further management
fields.description: Whether the patient was referred to you for further management, and by whom if stated

fields.label: Date of admission
fields.description: Date the patient was admitted to hospital (DD/MM/YYYY). Leave missing if not hospitalised.

fields.label: Date of discharge
fields.description: Date the patient was discharged from hospital (DD/MM/YYYY). Leave missing if not hospitalised.

fields.label: Treatment / surgical procedure
fields.description: The type of treatment and/or surgery performed

fields.label: Date(s) of treatment / operation
fields.description: Date(s) the treatment or operation was performed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Medical leave from
fields.description: First day of medical leave issued (DD/MM/YYYY). Leave missing if no MC was issued.

fields.label: Medical leave to
fields.description: Last day of medical leave issued (DD/MM/YYYY). Leave missing if no MC was issued.

fields.label: Prevents patient's occupation
fields.description: Whether the injuries would prevent the patient from engaging in their occupation, elaborating if Yes

fields.label: Fully recovered
fields.description: Whether the patient has fully recovered from the injuries. Answer Yes or No.

fields.label: Date returned / expected to return to work
fields.description: Date the patient returned to work, or the date they are expected to (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Illness prolonging disability
fields.description: Any illness the patient was suffering from that would contribute to or prolong the period of disability. Answer No unless the notes say otherwise.

fields.label: Additional information
fields.description: Any further information that would assist assessment of the claim, only if the notes support it
